# `fluxsim validate`

Check a bundle against the FLUX schema and its cross-document rules. Reads only; writes nothing.

## Synopsis

```text
fluxsim validate [options] <bundle>
```

## Examples

```bash
# check a bundle; nothing is written
fluxsim validate ./bundle
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `bundle` | path to the FLUX bundle directory |

## Options

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-j, --json` |  | emit machine-readable JSON |
